prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: portrait handbag moodboard for the Bags N-Z brand review and iOS recommendation app. Create a polished vertical 2:3 editorial product moodboard that captures the current Sandy Liang handbag vibe accurately: nostalgic downtown New York femininity with playful school-uniform and ballet references, grounded in crisp, compact, slightly quirky product design rather than generic coquette styling. Show six distinct handbag silhouettes: a glossy black compact east-west rectangular shoulder bag with two slim handles and one restrained bow; a glossy cylindrical pencil-case handbag with dual handles and a tiny bow; a white glossy croc-embossed rectangular shoulder bag with subtle star appliques; a black soft sash/crossbody pouch with one long bow-tail strap; an oversized black or deep-brunette heavyweight nylon tote with satin webbing straps and a small bow; and a tiny navy novelty pouch with a subtle elephant-inspired shape or motif. Add only two supporting detail crops: silver star zipper charms and a narrow satin bow-tail/zipper detail. Use a clean off-white studio-paper collage with restrained navy, black, brown, white and ice-blue accents. Products dominate; no people. Use crisp soft studio lighting and tactile patent leather, croc embossing, polished leather, satin and sport nylon. Every bag must have a different silhouette and material treatment. Bows are controlled product details, never oversized costume bows. No typography, brand name, initials, labels, logos, captions or watermarks. Avoid generic pink coquette styling, giant ribbon decorations, rose appliques, ruched satin evening bags, chain-heavy biker bags, cream top-handle bags with enormous bows, floral bouquets, repeated products, duplicate colourways, beach or raffia styling, and beige minimalist-luxury anonymity.
refinement_notes: Replaced a generic pink coquette board with current Sandy Liang cues: compact glossy shapes, pencil-case and sash bags, star details, a utilitarian nylon tote, and a navy elephant novelty pouch.
